assessments.name: Presentation (video exercise and written rational).
assessments.description: Create a short 5-10 min video (and 500 word written rational) that presents a counter narrative or hidden history relating to a place or person in Sydney. Videos will be screened and discussed in class.

assessments.name: Major essay draft
assessments.description: The first 1500 words of the major essay in draft form.

assessments.name: Major essay
assessments.description: The final major essay (3500 words) asks students to select a piece of public history (eg. museum, heritage site, documentary, or public memorial) and critically evaluate its effectiveness in conveying historical narratives to the public.

assessments.name: Participation
assessments.description: Prepared, scholarly participation in class discussions throughout semester (in person and online).
